purpose: Canonical input contract for first-release versus current-revised signal sensitivity testing.

semantics.dates: Market-availability dates for first-release panel; observation-period dates for current-revised panel are NOT acceptable unless separately converted to market-availability dates.
semantics.values: Values known as of each corresponding date.
semantics.category: Frozen engine category, primarily Crescita or Lavoro.

checkpoint_rule: Use month-end/checkpoint dates after 2020-07-31; at each checkpoint include only values whose market-availability date is <= checkpoint.
outputs_required: count and percentage of changed checkpoints by currency/block
guardrails: No interpolation of unavailable vintage observations.
No threshold changes while evaluating the frozen engine.
If a source has only revised history, mark the series REVISED_ONLY rather than fabricate first-release values.
